entities.summary: Margaret Heffernan is an entrepreneur, CEO, writer and keynote speaker. She is currently a professor of Practice at the University of Bath School of Management in the UK and, in 2021, was inaugurated into the Thinkers50 Hall of Fame for her lasting contribution to Management Thinking.
